The main takeaway from our work is that
we have discovered a new class of materials, namely, ferroelectric/oxide interfaces, which are able to host spin-polarized electrons.
a spin-polarised 2DEG is formed at a polar discontinuity in a ferroelectric oxide, even when the bulk is non-magnetic, and that this spin-polarisation can be tuned by ferroelectric polarisation.
a ferroelectric/antiferroelectric/insulating interface can host a spin polarized 2DEG, and this 2DEG can be tuned by ferroelectric polarization.
